newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 1996 agricultural product imports rise.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 1996 agricultural product imports rise.

text.p: South Korea's agricultural product imports rose 21.8 percent in value terms to $6.91 billion in 1996 from $5.67 billion a year earlier, the Agriculture and Forestry Ministry said on Wednesday.
A ministry statement said livestock product imports also increased to $1.24 billion last year from $1.22 billion a year ago.
The statement attributed the imports rise to higher prices for the products in the international market.
In volume terms, South Korean wheat imports shot up by 36 percent to 3.18 million tonnes in 1996 from 2.34 million tonnes a year earlier.
But corn imports totalled 8.69 million tonnes in 1996, down 3.9 percent from 9.04 million a year earlier.
Purchases of foreign soybeans fell to 1,465,000 tonnes last year from 1,468,000 tonnes.
Beef imports fell slightly to 147,200 tonnes last year from 148,100 tonnes a year earlier, and pork imports declined to 53,000 tonnes from 53,200 tonnes.
The statement said pork exports surged 157 percent to 36,700 tonnes from 14,300 tonnes a year earlier.
